auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient_Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.CRP <> 'negative'
  AND T1.CRP IS NOT NULL
  AND T2.`Examination Date` IS NULL
